summary: tracker_resolution.py momentum sorted the layer positions but kept the per-layer point resolutions in input order, so unsorted positions with unequal resolutions got the curvature error of another layout.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective code is in the script as first released (hep-research 0.14.0, commit 6721da68)

observables: sigma_curvature_per_m, the momentum-resolution terms and the MDR of tracker_resolution.py momentum
impact.bias: --positions-m 0.3 0.6 0.0 0.9 --point-resolution-um 100 100 2 2 gave sigma_k = 3.526e-4 /m instead of 7.858e-4 /m (resolution a factor 2.2 too small, MDR 2.2 too high); either sign is possible
impact.trigger: momentum with more than one --point-resolution-um value and --positions-m not in increasing order

outputs.how_to_recognize: JSON on stdout with intrinsic.sigma_curvature_per_m whose inputs list point_resolution_um with more than one value and positions_m not sorted

remedy: rerun tracker_resolution.py momentum on a release that has the fix, or give the positions in increasing order
